title: MetadataCompletionPayload
description: Payload for Metadata Completion tasks: what an asset still needs before its lifecycle workflow lets it leave the current stage (ADR:2026-10-15-a-lifecycle-stage-asks-for-its-missing-metadata-in-one-task). Only the server writes it.

workflow.description: Name of the workflow definition whose stage asks for the fields.

node.description: Name of the node in that workflow that lists the required fields.

stage.description: Stage the asset has to be in for the task to apply.

targetStage.description: Stage the asset moves to once the fields are filled in and any approval passes.

missingFields.description: Paths of the required fields that are still empty, in the order the stage lists them.

conditionsMet.description: False while the stage's lifecycle conditions are not met.

revision.description: Present on a Revise and resubmit task: the stage's approval was rejected and the asset is to be revised (ADR:2026-10-21-a-rejected-lifecycle-approval-asks-for-a-revision-and-the-next-edit-resubmits-it).

comment.description: What the reviewer asked to change, when they left a comment.

requestedBy.description: Name of the user who rejected the approval.
